name: Hophni
bio: Hophni was the son of the priest Eli, who served as a priest at Shiloh alongside his brother Phinehas, yet acted wickedly and did not know the LORD. He and his brother seized for themselves portions of the offerings that belonged to God and slept with women who gathered at the entrance to the tent of meeting, causing the people to treat the LORD's offering with contempt (1 Samuel 2:12-17, 22). A man of God came and warned Eli that his two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, would die on the same day, as a sign of the LORD's judgment on Eli's entire house (1 Samuel 2:34). Israel later went to war against the Philistines at Aphek, and the people brought the ark into the camp hoping it would bring victory; Hophni and Phinehas went out with the ark, but Israel was defeated again, the ark was captured, and both brothers were killed that day, exactly as the man of God had prophesied (1 Samuel 4:1-11).
